Category: Technology
Importance: 8
In 1983, version 4.2 of the Berkeley Software Distribution (BSD) UNIX operating system introduced the Berkeley sockets networking model, which significantly enhanced access to network services. This innovation led to standardized network access and paved the way for the widespread adoption of protocols such as TCP/IP and UDP/IP, changing the landscape of computing and networking fundamentally. The sockets model ultimately became integral to modern operating systems, influencing a myriad of applications and network services that are still in use today.

 - The introduction of BSD sockets revolutionized networking by providing a consistent interface for connecting to network services.
 - This model led to the widespread adoption of TCP/IP protocols, which are foundational to modern internet communications.
 - The impact of BSD 4.2 and its socket implementation set the stage for networked computing as we know it.

Source: https://blog.apnic.net/2026/07/28/hooray-for-the-sockets-interface/

The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has set a deadline for the PJM Interconnection to implement governance and stakeholder reforms by the end of September, or else FERC will enforce its own changes. PJM has experienced issues with decision-making and stakeholder confidence, leading to a lack of new generation capacity and calls for structural changes to its governance process.

 - PJM must adopt governance reforms or face imposition of changes by FERC.
 - PJM's capacity auctions have been failing to attract significant new generation.

Category: Business
Importance: 8
The Federal Energy Regulatory Commission (FERC) has set a deadline for the PJM Interconnection to implement governance reforms by the end of September, or FERC will impose changes. The proposed reforms aim to address governance issues and restore confidence among market participants, particularly after PJM faced significant challenges attracting new generation capacity and managing stakeholder processes. The outcome of this situation could affect the operations of PJM, which serves multiple states and is critical to the region's energy supply.

 - FERC is mandating governance reforms for PJM to restore market confidence.
 - PJM has struggled to attract new generation capacity, leading to potential interventions by FERC.

Source: https://www.zerohedge.com/energy/ferc-will-impose-reforms-if-pjm-fails-adopt-changes-september-chairman-warns
